# uid

The goal of uid is to streamline the processing of temperature data
exported from UID devices. It provides functions for cleaning, outlier
detection, downsampling, and diagnostic plotting, assuming a structured
directory layout for raw and processed data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of uid like so:

``` r
devtools::install_github("matiasandina/uid")
```

## Directory Structure

The package assumes the following directory layout:

``` R
temperature/
├── raw_data/   # Place raw UID .CSV files here
└── data/       # Cleaned, downsampled outputs will be written here
```

## Example

``` r
library(uid)

# Process all raw UID CSVs from a directory
process_all_uid_files(
  raw_export_dir = "temperature/raw_data",
  output_dir = "temperature/data"
)
```

This will:

- Group files by shared base name (e.g. handling \_1_of_n format)
- Remove temperature outliers
- Downsample by 1-minute intervals (by default)
- Save cleaned data and diagnostic plots

The cleaning workflow assumes that each `rfid` belongs to a single
`matrix_name` within a session. If the same `rfid` is detected on more
than one matrix,
[`clean_raw_uid()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/clean_raw_uid.md)
and
[`process_all_uid_files()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/process_all_uid_files.md)
now print a summary table with `session_name`, `rfid`, `matrix_name`,
`n`, `%`, `min_dt`, and `max_dt`.

This usually reflects stray detections caused by matrices being placed
too close to each other, or by a cage being briefly placed on the wrong
platform. If the duplicate detections are a small minority of rows, the
package asks for explicit confirmation before removing rows from the
matrix with the lower percentage of detections. If those duplicate
detections exceed 10% for a given `session_name` / `rfid` pair,
processing stops and the file should be reviewed manually.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can also use lower-level functions for more custom workflows:

``` r
df <- read_raw_uid_csv("path/to/file.csv")
df_flagged <- flag_temperature_outliers(df, threshold = 1)
df_clean <- df_flagged |> dplyr::filter(!outlier_global)
df_downsampled <- downsample_temperature(df_clean)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calculate_activity()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/calculate_activity.md)
  : Calculate Activity Index Based on Zone Transitions
- [`check_overwrite_permissions()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/check_overwrite_permissions.md)
  : Check for Existing Output Files and Prompt Overwrite Options
- [`clean_raw_uid()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/clean_raw_uid.md)
  : Wrapper to clean UID temperature CSV: read, flag outliers,
  downsample, and plot
- [`downsample_activity()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/downsample_activity.md)
  : Downsample activity index data to fixed intervals
- [`downsample_temperature()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/downsample_temperature.md)
  : Downsample temperature data to fixed intervals
- [`estimate_sampling_interval()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/estimate_sampling_interval.md)
  : Estimate Sampling Interval from Grouped Data
- [`flag_temperature_outliers()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/flag_temperature_outliers.md)
  : Flag temperature outliers based on rolling difference threshold
- [`interpolate_gaps()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/interpolate_gaps.md)
  : Interpolate Short Gaps in UID Time Series Data
- [`plot_downsampled_temperature()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/plot_downsampled_temperature.md)
  : Plot and save downsampled temperature trace
- [`plot_outliers()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/plot_outliers.md)
  : Plot and save outlier diagnostic
- [`process_all_uid_files()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/process_all_uid_files.md)
  : Process All UID CSV Files in Batch
- [`quantify_temp_bouts()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/quantify_temp_bouts.md)
  : Quantify bouts of temperature above or below a threshold
- [`read_raw_uid_csv()`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/read_raw_uid_csv.md)
  : Read and clean raw UID CSV file
- [`uid_sample_data`](https://matiasandina.github.io/uid/reference/uid_sample_data.md)
  : Example UID Sample Data
